concerns.text: T002 requires computing context stability S_t 'cosine similarity of retrieved chunks via the retriever', but no task produces the retriever or student-model wrapper the plan defines (code/models/retriever.py, code/models/student_model.py). T001 only creates the empty code/models/ directory. This is a missing producer task: T002/T003 consume a component nothing builds. Add a task implementing the model/retriever wrappers before T002.

T005 is tagged [P] but instructs to 'fix any source-file lint errors it exposes' in code/. T007–T010 (also [P], same parallel batch) create/rewrite source files in code/utils, code/environments, code/agents, code/metrics. Concurrent lint-fixing of files other parallel tasks are editing is hidden shared state — the [P] tag is unsafe. Either drop [P] from T005, restrict its fixes to config files, or sequence it after the T007–T010 batch.

T011 is [P] and listed in the parallel repair batch, but it depends on T004's pinned requirements (transformers, sentence-transformers, psutil) being installed. The 'Order' note says repairs are 'runnable in parallel after T004/T006', which covers it, but the task body itself should state the T004 dependency to prevent a fresh executor from running it against an unpopulated virtualenv.
